messages.content: 想像一下你是一個無人機操作員。你目前正在操作一架位於天空中的無人機，座標為（5，7）。你被要求將無人機移動到一個新的座標（10，15）。到達新座標後，你又被要求將無人機移動到另一個座標（20，25）。你能用歐幾里得範數法計算出無人機總共飛行的距離嗎？

function.name: math_hypot
function.description: Calculate the Euclidean norm, sqrt(sum(squares)), the length of the vector from the origin to point (x, y) which is the hypotenuse of the right triangle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

z.description: Optional. The z-coordinate value. Default is 0.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to imagine being a drone operator moving from (5,7) to (10,15), then to (20,25). They want to calculate total flight distance using Euclidean norm. We need to compute distances between points: distance from (5,7) to (10,15) and from (10,15) to (20,25). Then sum them. Use Euclidean norm sqrt((dx)^2 + (dy)^2). The user specifically says "用歐幾里得範數法計算出無人機總共飛行的距離". So we need to compute distances. We can use the tool functions.math_hypot. But that function calculates sqrt(x^2 + y^2 + z^2). We can call it twice: first for dx=5, dy=8? Wait difference: (10-5)=5, (15-7)=8. So sqrt(5^2+8^2)=sqrt(25+64)=sqrt(89)=9.433... Then second: (20-10)=10, (25-15)=10. sqrt(10^2+10^2)=sqrt(200)=14.142... Sum: 9.433... + 14.142... = 23.575... approx 23.58. So total flight distance ~23.58 units.

We should call the tool twice. Let's do that.
